description: Historische Hochwassermarke is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. The flood marks document water levels of actual flood events and provide essential information to determine the hydraulic modeling of actual events. For a long time, they were the only way to document expired flood events and their effects on populated floodplains and to pass these experiences on to offspring. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Historical flood mark" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include oac: 316, Katastrophenschutz, Hochwasserschutz. The listing shows 2006-12-15 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
